**Instructions for Use:**
1. Write this document before beginning technical design
2. Focus on the customer's perspective throughout
3. Use specific, concrete examples rather than abstract descriptions
4. Include real customer research and feedback where possible
5. Make the customer journey tangible and detailed
6. Consider both functional and emotional aspects of the experience
7. Update as you learn more about customers during development
8. Use this document to guide all product decisions
9. Share with the entire team to align on customer value
